page.layout: One printed page: a woodcut emblem with an oval cartouche and a monogram, centred on the page. Faint printed lines at the top, right of centre, above the emblem.
page.notes: Woodcut emblem: an ornamental border of scrolls, fruit garlands and grotesque masks, with a central oval cartouche. Inside the oval is the inscription "ANDREAS" on the left and "SNERE" (possibly partly cut off) on the right, with a monogram of initials and a figure at the centre. The faint lines at the top are too worn and pale to read; they are marked illegible. No page number, running head or signature is visible.
